Customer Review: The Foundry Bakery

By: Ingrid Halvorsen
Date: 3 February
Rating: ★★★★☆

I went to The Foundry Bakery with some former classmates from my baking course. We chose it because it opens at 7:00 A.M. on weekdays, and a couple of us start work very early.

On the whole I was pleased with the visit. The sourdough was superb and the pastry counter was genuinely impressive. The room itself is warm and beautifully fitted out. The staff, too, were very attentive. They made some useful suggestions about what we should try and brought everything over quickly. My one complaint is that there was not enough parking. The yard behind the bakery holds only a few vehicles, and there were no spaces available on the street nearby. I would suggest taking the bus or the train if you visit.
